name: Website
title: Website: operator and guest paths and what can go wrong

BANDS.s: Website module permissions and the sub-pages the operator can reach
Templates and drafts page, first draft from a template, data pre-filled from the restaurant and the Brand Book
The builder: pages, sections, menu, text, colours, media, links, forms, maps, header, footer, popups, devices
Brand Book sync, preview and the ADA accessibility scan before publishing
Temporary domain or custom domain, DNS and SSL, the build workflow, status and recovery
What the visitor sees and does: fonts, navigation, menu, links into ordering, maps, popups, forms
What happens after a guest submits a form and where the operator sees it
Edit and republish, platform releases, restaurant data changes, unpublish and offboarding
Website overview stats, SEO page, Search Console and analytics tags

NODES.d: The operator opens Marketing, Website in Web Dash for the selected location. The website belongs to one restaurant (location), not to the whole business.
e: Operator on a multi-location business edits the website of the wrong location because the location switcher is not obvious in the builder
Module not switched on or no Website permission, page silently missing from the sidebar with no explanation
Operator thinks the feature is broken

NODES.d: The Website group shows Overview, Design (templates and builder), Announcements, SEO and Forms, each behind its own read permission under the Website module permission. Domain settings live inside the builder publish flow, not on a separate page.
e: Permissions are checked in the sidebar and on read, but a role with read access can still reach publish or domain actions if the action is not checked on the server
Overview shows empty charts on first visit before any site is published or Google is connected, with no first-run guidance
Operator does not know where to start
Restaurant alias missing for the location, so later publishing to the temporary domain fails with Restaurant alias not found

NODES.d: Design lists the templates and the restaurant's drafts with a status of draft, published temporary or published live. Drafts can be created, renamed, archived, unarchived and deleted; the live website cannot be archived or deleted (Live websites cannot be archived or deleted).
e: Draft deleted while it is the published temporary site, the temporary URL keeps serving an orphaned copy
Stale site with no way to edit it
Status badge is worked out from the domain settings, so if the published id is cleared by a domain change the live site shows as draft
Operator loses track of which draft is live
Two drafts with similar names and no last-published date make it easy to edit the wrong one
Changes made to a draft that is not live
Delete removes the draft from both stores with no undo or recycle bin

NODES.d: The operator picks a template and a new draft is created from it with an optional draft name. Only one website record per draft; the template sets the starting pages and sections. No AI generated site or copy was found in the live code.
e: Switching template on an existing draft replaces pages and sections, custom content is lost without a clear warning
Template ships with sections the restaurant does not have (catering, loyalty, gift cards), left in and published with dead links
Guests hit empty or broken sections
Draft created twice on a double click, two near identical drafts appear

NODES.d: On first load the builder pulls restaurant details, integrations, domain settings and the Brand Book (fonts, logos, colours, social links) into the draft and stores a copy of the Brand Book with its updated date. Site URL is set from the domain settings at this point.
e: Brand Book fonts not marked Done are missing, so heading, sub heading or paragraph styles fall back to template defaults
Site does not match the brand
Restaurant address, phone or hours are copied into the draft once and do not follow later changes in restaurant settings
Site URL written while only the temporary domain exists and not refreshed when a custom domain is added later
Canonical and sitemap point at the temporary domain
Brand Book empty for a new restaurant, the site starts with generic template colours and placeholder logo

NODES.d: The builder loads the draft and auto-saves changes as small patches after a short pause, with a save on leaving the page. Undo and redo walk the local change history.
e: Two operators edit the same draft, patches from both are applied without locking and one person's change is silently lost or merged into a broken page
Patch fails to apply on the server (stale base after another save), the error is swallowed and the operator believes it saved
Closing the tab within the save delay drops the last change
Undo after a Brand Book sync or template switch restores only part of the change
Large drafts with many images load slowly or freeze the editor

NODES.d: The operator adds pages (standard pages such as Menu, About, Contact, Catering, Privacy policy, custom), sets the page name, URL slug and page SEO settings, and orders them in the navigation. Slugs are validated for format.
e: Two pages given the same slug, one of them is unreachable after publishing
Page missing on the live site
Renaming a slug breaks buttons and links that pointed at the old page, with no warning
Broken links on the live site
Deleting a page leaves it in the header or footer navigation
Page hidden from navigation still appears in the sitemap

NODES.d: From the section library the operator adds sections (hero, about, menu, featured menu, deals, spotlights, testimonials, gallery, Instagram, FAQ, form, call to action, location, gift card, catering, loyalty, tiers, packages, custom), reorders them by drag and drop, hides, deletes or duplicates them on the same page or onto other pages.
e: A call to action or form section appears across pages where the operator did not add it
Extra sections appear in the builder without being added
Cluttered site, operator distrusts the builder
Duplicated section keeps the same internal ids as the original, so editing one changes both or edits are lost
Drag and drop drops a section on the wrong page or in the wrong order on mobile
Deleting a section that holds a form leaves the form and its submissions orphaned on the Forms page

NODES.d: The menu section lists menus, categories and items from Menu Manager with category headings, layout variants and a category dropdown. Item data is pulled when the site is built, so the live menu is a snapshot of Menu Manager at publish time.
e: Category heading show or hide toggle has no effect on the menu page while the font size control works
Item renamed, repriced, hidden or 86ed in Menu Manager after publishing, the website keeps the old snapshot until republished
Guest sees wrong prices or unavailable items
Items with no image or long names break the grid layout
Menu with time based availability shows all items at all times on the website
Guests expect items that are not served now
Very large menus make the build slow or time out

NODES.d: Global font styles (heading, sub heading, body, button) and per-text overrides set family, weight, size, line height and letter spacing per device. The inline text editor allows letter spacing from minus 50 to 20, while other controls and the Brand Book only allow zero or more.
e: Zero and negative letter spacing not available in some text controls, so the operator cannot match the brand design
Custom uploaded font shows in the editor but is not bundled with the published site
Fonts fall back on the live site
Font weight chosen that the font family does not provide, browser fakes a bold or italic
Per-device size set on desktop only, mobile inherits a size that overflows

NODES.d: Each section picks one of the colour styles (light and dark variants built from the theme) that sets background, text, button and form field colours. Brand Book colours are available as the palette.
e: Custom form fields and labels take the page text colour instead of the section colour style, so on a light colour style the form is invisible
Guests cannot see or fill the form
Footer colour style chosen in the builder is not applied the same way on the published site
Low contrast combinations allowed without warning
Changing a Brand Book colour does not update colour styles already in use

NODES.d: The operator uploads or picks images and videos from the content library, sets focal point, crop and transforms, and builds galleries and carousels. Files are stored on S3 and served from the CDN.
e: Very large images or videos uploaded without compression, live pages load slowly on mobile
Image deleted from the content library still referenced by the site, shows broken after the next publish
Broken images on the live site
Focal point set on desktop crops the subject out on mobile

NODES.d: Buttons, inline hyperlinks and FAQ links open a link modal: Standard page (page and optional section) or External link with a URL check, label and new tab option. The Order Online link is usually an external link to the online ordering page.
e: Valid Order Online URL rejected with Invalid URL on primary and secondary buttons, because the URL check refuses uppercase letters, query strings or long domain endings
Operator cannot link to online ordering
Different link editors use different URL checks, a URL accepted in one place is refused in another
Link to a section anchor breaks when the section is deleted or moved to another page
Order Online link hard coded to one location on a multi-location brand
Orders go to the wrong store

NODES.d: Form sections (contact, custom, catering, loyalty sign-up and popup forms) have questions of several types, required flags, a success message and notification recipients. Forms can be duplicated within the site.
e: Existing questions cannot be edited in a duplicated form
No notification recipient set, submissions arrive with nobody told
Required consent checkbox missing on a sign-up form that adds guests to marketing
Form renamed after submissions exist, older submissions grouped under the old name

NODES.d: FAQ section with question and answer pairs, links inside answers and spacing controls.
e: Spacing between FAQ items and around the section does not follow the controls or the design
Link inside an answer refused by the URL check or saved without a protocol

NODES.d: Location section shows address, phone, map and business hours from the restaurant settings, with map styling options. Hours shown on the live site are the values present when the site was last built.
e: Business hours updated in restaurant settings do not reach the website
Guests turn up when the store is closed
Holiday or special hours not shown on the website
Split shifts or overnight hours displayed in the wrong order or time format
Wrong pin for an address that geocodes badly
Guests sent to the wrong place

NODES.t: Gift card, catering, loyalty, deals sections
NODES.d: Sections that pull from other AIO modules: gift card categories, catering packages, loyalty tiers and sign-up, deals, spotlights and reviews. Their data is fetched when the site is built.
e: Deal or spotlight expires or is deleted, the website keeps showing it until republished
Guest expects an offer that is gone
Gift card section added while digital gift cards are not set up for online, the buy link leads nowhere
Loyalty tiers changed in Marketing after publish, website shows old tiers and points
Fetch of module data fails during the build, the section silently renders empty
Empty section on the live site

NODES.d: Header with logo, navigation items and dropdowns, call to action button, sticky and mobile menu; footer with colour style, hours, address and social links taken from the Brand Book.
e: Footer colour style differs between builder and live site
Social link icons shown with empty links after a Brand Book sync
Logo too large or wrong variant in the mobile header

NODES.d: Global popups (announcement, form popup, sign-up popup that creates a guest, cookie consent) with triggers and styling; the Announcements page manages announcement content shown on the site.
e: Cookie consent off or misconfigured while analytics and pixels run
Popup shows on every page view because dismissal is not remembered
Sign-up popup adds guests without clear marketing terms
Announcement end date passes but it stays live until republish

NODES.d: The operator switches between desktop, tablet and mobile views and sets per-device overrides for sizes, spacing and visibility.
e: Mobile view in the builder does not match a real phone (fonts, dropdowns, sticky header)
Per-device override hides a section on mobile that holds the only Order Online button
Tablet view rarely checked, layout breaks in between breakpoints

NODES.t: Brand Book changed since last sync?
NODES.d: When the builder opens it compares the Brand Book updated date with the copy stored in the draft. If newer, it shows a New changes made in brand book modal (Later or Sync now), then a reminder banner if postponed.
e: Change detection only runs when the builder is open, so a live site never learns of Brand Book changes on its own
Modal shows again on every load if the stored date is not saved after Later

NODES.d: Sync now copies Brand Book fonts (only properties that changed since the last sync), social links, logos and colours into the draft. Colours land in the palette but do not rewrite colour styles. The live site changes only after a republish.
e: Sync overwrites manual font changes the operator made in the builder for the same property
Operator expects the live site to change after Sync now but nothing happens until republish
Sync fails silently when the Brand Book request fails, the success snackbar still shows

NODES.d: Preview renders the draft with the same shared section components as the live site, inside Web Dash, per device.
e: Preview uses the latest shared components while the live site was built on an older release, so they differ
Operator sees one thing, guests another
Fonts and maps work in preview but fail on the published site
Data driven sections in preview show current data, the live site shows the snapshot from the last build

NODES.d: The builder runs an automated accessibility scan (axe-core) on each page and device, lists violations and stores the latest scan on the website; the Overview shows an ADA compliance card from it.
e: ADA compliance report wrong or not loading on production
Operator cannot rely on the report
Latest scan cached for a day, fixes made today still show the old result
Scan runs on the builder canvas, not on the published site, so live only issues are missed
Automated scan presented as compliance although it covers only part of the guidelines

NODES.d: From the publish modal the operator publishes to the temporary domain (shared staging, up to 3 versions per restaurant) or to the live custom domain, which needs a verified domain and certificate.
e: Operator publishes a draft to live by mistake when meaning to test on the temporary domain
Publish clicked while the last auto-save is still pending, the build uses older content
No check for missing essentials (Order Online link, hours, privacy policy) before publishing

NODES.d: For the temporary domain the draft gets a subfolder named from the restaurant alias and a counter 1 to 3 on a shared bucket. A fourth version is refused: Maximum of 3 staging versions allowed.
e: Limit of 3 temporary versions reached, the operator must unpublish one first and the message does not say which
Two drafts published at once get the same free counter
Alias changed after publishing, old subfolder left behind

NODES.d: The operator enters the domain, AIO creates a hosted zone and requests an SSL certificate, and shows the nameservers or DNS records to set at the registrar. Existing records (www, subdomains, mail) are read so they can be carried over.
e: Moving nameservers drops the restaurant's existing mail or other records that were not copied over
Domain typed with www or a typo, the hosted zone and certificate are created for the wrong name
Operator lacks registrar access, onboarding stalls with no hand-off to AIO Ops

NODES.d: Publishing live is refused until nameservers resolve and the certificate is issued. The status is checked against the certificate each time domain settings load.
e: DNS propagation takes hours, the operator retries and sees the same error with no time estimate
Certificate request expires after validation is not completed in time, a new request is needed
Verified status read from a slow call on every load, the builder hangs while waiting

NODES.d: For a live publish AIO creates or reuses the restaurant's bucket and CloudFront distribution with the custom domain and certificate attached.
e: Distribution created without the alternate domain or certificate, site serves a certificate error
Partial failure leaves a bucket without a distribution, publish refused for missing CloudFront distribution

NODES.d: AIO triggers a GitHub workflow that fetches the website data, builds the static site (pulling menu, deals, spotlights, gift cards and tiers at build time), uploads it to the bucket or temporary subfolder and invalidates the CDN cache.
e: The published site uses a different font from the builder
A restaurant website fails to publish
Workflow trigger succeeds but the run cannot be found, status stays unknown
Build uses the platform release current at publish time, not the one the operator previewed
CDN invalidation misses some paths, guests see a mix of old and new pages

NODES.d: The builder polls the workflow status and shows in progress, success, failure or cancelled with the publish date and a link to the site. Publishing an eligible verified custom domain can also start restaurant email sender setup. Email verification proceeds separately from the website build.
e: Shows published but the temporary link does not work
Preview link for the temporary domain not working after publishing
Status stuck in progress when polling stops or the run is lost
Operator cannot tell if the site is live

NODES.d: After a live publish the workflow asks AIO to verify the domain in Google Search Console (DNS TXT record) and submit the sitemap, if Google is connected and the certificate is valid.
e: The published sitemap contains temporary domain URLs
Verification fails because the TXT record has not propagated within the short wait
Google not connected, sitemap submission skipped with no message to the operator

NODES.d: After a failure the operator can retry the publish or cancel a running workflow; a temporary version can be unpublished, which deletes its subfolder and clears the CDN cache. Unpublishing a custom domain disables its branded campaign email sender.
e: Publish fails and Unpublish does not work, so the site cannot be republished on the temporary domain
Cancel marks the run cancelled while files were already partly uploaded
Repeated retries start several builds that finish out of order

NODES.d: The guest opens the custom domain or temporary URL. Published pages serve the built design and assets. Some sections, including the campaign announcement popup, request current restaurant content when displayed.
e: Fonts fall back to a default serif on the live site
Temporary site is indexable and competes with the real site in search
Certificate expired or not renewed, browser shows a security warning
Slow first load on mobile from large media

NODES.d: Announcement, sign-up and cookie consent popups show according to their triggers; analytics and pixels load only after targeting consent.
e: Tags fire before consent is given
Popup covers the Order Online button on mobile with no visible close

NODES.d: Header navigation highlights the current page; buttons link to other pages, sections or external sites.
e: Active page not highlighted correctly in the navigation on every website
A published button navigates to the wrong destination
Dropdown navigation does not open on touch devices

NODES.d: Menu page shows categories with headings and a category dropdown, items, prices and item pages from the snapshot taken at publish.
e: Category dropdown is clipped and the second item is cut off mid text
Prices or items out of date versus online ordering
Allergen or dietary info missing although it exists in Menu Manager

NODES.t: Order Online, gift card or catering link
NODES.d: Buttons hand the guest to AIO online ordering, the digital gift card purchase page, catering or loyalty sign-up.
e: Digital gift cards link returns a 404
Order Online link points to a closed or wrong location
Orders from the website are not attributed to the website in reports

NODES.d: The location section shows the map, address, phone and hours.
e: The embedded map fails to load on the restaurant website
Hours shown are those at the last publish, not current
Phone number not clickable on mobile

NODES.d: The guest fills a contact, catering, custom or popup form, including file uploads, and submits it to a public AIO endpoint. Sign-up popups reject a repeat email or phone.
e: Form fields invisible because of the colour style
No captcha or rate limit, spam submissions flood the inbox and the Guestbook
File upload too large or wrong type fails with no message
Submit error not shown, guest believes it was sent

NODES.d: AIO stores the submission, uploads files to S3, emails a confirmation to the guest and a notification to the form recipients through the email queue, and for sign-up popups creates the guest in the Guestbook with a segment.
e: Notification email to recipients fails and the error is only logged
Guest created from a popup without consent fields stored
Duplicate guest created when the same person signs up with a different email

NODES.d: The Forms page lists forms and their submissions for the location.
e: Submissions from a deleted or duplicated form missing or grouped wrongly
No export or status to track follow up

NODES.d: Any change, including data that comes from other modules, reaches guests only after a republish.
e: Operator edits the draft and forgets to republish
Republish of a different draft replaces the live site

NODES.d: A release changes shared section components, defaults and settings. Published sites change only when rebuilt, but a release can also change stored settings or defaults that the next build uses.
e: GTM tag toggle turned off after a release, tags stop firing on rebuild
Restaurant loses tracking and ad data
New component defaults change the layout of sites on their next republish
A built page still serves a component version from before the fix
The reported display problem persists until that site is rebuilt

NODES.d: Menu, hours, deals, gift cards, tiers and address change in other modules after publishing.
e: Updated business hours do not sync to the website
Deleted menu item still has an indexed item page
Guests find items that do not exist

NODES.d: Unpublishing a temporary version deletes its subfolder, clears the cache and frees the slot.
e: Unpublish fails part way, the slot stays taken
Cannot publish a new temporary version
Cached copies still served after unpublish

NODES.d: Removing the domain deletes the hosted zone and certificate and clears the live website link; the restaurant must move its nameservers back.
e: Hosted zone deleted while nameservers still point to it, the domain and mail go dark
Site files and bucket left running after churn
Search Console property and verification left in place

NODES.d: The temporary version or the live domain no longer serves the site.
e: Guests and Google still have links to the old site

NODES.d: Overview shows traffic, real-time users, inbound and outbound channels, click-through, page speed and the ADA card, from AIO's Google Analytics property, page speed checks and the stored scan.
e: Stats empty or wrong when the site is not tagged with AIO's analytics property
Date range converted in the wrong time zone, daily totals off
Website orders not linked to visits, no conversion figure

NODES.d: SEO page shows site health, indexed pages, top search terms, top pages and traffic trends, and holds the SEO settings; Search Console needs Google connected and a verified custom domain.
e: No SEO checklist guiding the operator through titles, descriptions, alt text and schema
Search Console data missing until verification, with no explanation

NODES.d: The operator sets a Google Tag Manager id, GA4 ids and Meta or TikTok pixels with on or off toggles; they are written into the site at build time.
e: The GTM toggle turns off following a release
Tag id changed but not republished, old id keeps firing
Data goes to the wrong account

NOTES: The site build captures design and content used at publish time. The announcement popup separately fetches active campaign data and checks its schedule. Verify the affected section before attributing stale content to the last publish.
Website sub-pages confirmed from the sidebar: Overview, Design, Announcements, SEO, Forms. A separate Leads page was not found in the sidebar although a leads endpoint exists in the backend.
No AI generated site or copy was found in the live builder code.
Whether permission checks for publish and domain actions are enforced on the server as well as the sidebar was not confirmed (TBC with engineering).
The URL check behind PROD-4841 and PROD-4923 was a regex refusing uppercase, query strings and long domain endings; the link modal now uses another check, but other editors may still use the old one.
Build-dependent changes take effect on a rebuild. The release and rebuild history of a particular restaurant requires operational confirmation.
Form spam protection (captcha or rate limit) was not found on the public submit endpoint; duplicate rejection exists only for guest-creating popups.
Brand Book tickets PROD-4836 and PROD-4781 are attached in the Brand Book map, not here.
